# wirespec test fixtures

`oas-3.1-schema.json` is the OpenAPI 3.1 document schema from <https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2022-10-07>, the copy wiregen's own tests use. `TestOpenAPI_ValidatesAgainstOAS31` validates `docs/openapi.json` against it. Refresh it from the same URL; a newer dated schema replaces the file.
